Local SEO for car dealerships

Win buyers from across a wide catchment, not just your own town — see where the lot ranks everywhere a shopper searches from.

Start with 10 free scans

Win buyers from across the whole catchment

A car is worth a long drive, so a dealership pulls buyers from far wider than any coffee shop — and the map ranks it differently from every town in that reach. Every “Toyota dealer” or “used cars near me” that ranks a rival lot first in one of those towns is a sale that drove somewhere else. A single rank number can’t see across that catchment. Eagle Eye lays a wide grid over the whole reach and shows where you win and where you don’t.

Cover the reach a car buyer travels

  • Wide-catchment rank — a 21 × 21 grid of up to 441 points, set to the real distance buyers come from.
  • ARP — how high the lot places on the points where it appears across that reach.
  • A competitor map per rival — the dealerships winning the towns on the edge of your catchment.
  • Both maps — buyers research on Google and Apple long before they drive in.

Start free: 10 scans, a free first scan of your own lot up to 21 × 21, and credits that never expire. Running a group of lots? Track each on its own grid — see the plans.
